title: Wire the image agent
intro: Build the mockup agent's pipeline — two wires are forbidden, and each has a name.
briefing: Route a client's request to a delivered mockup. The inspector rejects any blueprint where generation runs without the brand's DNA (ungrounded generation) — or where an image reaches the deliverable without passing the judge (nothing ships unevaluated).

rules.label: The style guide is analysed into brand DNA first
Concepts merge the brief with the brand DNA
No ungrounded generation: the request never reaches the renderer directly
A request can actually become a deliverable

debrief: The chain — request → brand analysis → concepts → generate → evaluate → deliver — is the image agent's SYSTEM_PROMPT drawn as wiring. The two forbidden wires are the two classic shortcuts: generating without the brand DNA (you get pretty pictures that ignore the client), and delivering without the judge (you get whatever the model felt like). In the real agent the evaluate → generate feedback edge closes the retry loop: a failing score returns actionable feedback that's folded into the next prompt, with an attempt cap so the loop can't spin forever.
